svg.metadata: exo icon master. Mark: four bars turning around an open core, one per stage (spec, build, verify, ship). Dark tile so the cyan mark reads on light and dark grounds. icon-512.png from this file (macOS, headless Chrome): "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --hide-scrollbars \ --default-background-color=00000000 --window-size=512,512 --screenshot=assets/icon-512.png file://$PWD/assets/icon.svg
